title: Business positioning and production
answer: Pristine Apparel is a UK-facing wholesale sportswear and workwear manufacturer with production facilities in Pakistan. The website uses a specification-first, quote-first sales process.

title: Ranges and minimum order quantities
answer: Pristine Apparel has three ranges: Astra premium from 50 pieces per style/colour, Medium mid-premium from 150 pieces per style/colour, and Workwear / Workmon from 200 pieces per style/colour. These are minimums only; larger quantities can be quoted.

title: Wholesale product categories
answer: The wholesale website is structured around Football Kits, Training Wear, Tracksuits & Jackets, Custom Apparel, Workwear & Uniform, Private Label, and repeat or scale orders.

title: Custom colours, branding and sizes
answer: Wholesale enquiries can specify colourways, logos or branding, and size runs. The final branding method, materials and production specification are confirmed per order before commitment.

title: Astra material direction
answer: For Astra, suitable premium directions can include merino wool, technical polyester, performance stretch blends and high-end cotton-modal mixes. Exact composition, fabric weight, sampling details and size specification must be confirmed for the individual order.

title: Medium range material direction
answer: For the Medium range, the approved direction includes cotton-poly blends, mid-weight performance fabrics and durable sportswear materials. Final composition, weight and specification are confirmed per order.

title: Workwear material direction
answer: Workwear / Workmon is positioned around durable functional garments. Suitable directions can include heavy-duty cotton, reinforced poly-cotton and use-case-appropriate functional materials. Final fabric, wash, safety and certification requirements are confirmed for the specific order.

title: Private-label manufacturing
answer: Pristine Apparel supports private-label wholesale enquiries for brands and resellers. The brief can include garment and market, range, quantity, fabric, labels, trims, packaging, branding, sizing, required standards, destination and target timing. Samples, artwork, final specifications, pricing and timing are agreed before bulk production.

title: Wholesale ordering process
answer: The wholesale process is Enquiry → Specification → Quote → Approval → Production & QC → Delivery. The enquiry stage does not place an order or take payment.

title: Pricing and lead-time confirmation
answer: Wholesale pricing and lead time are not fixed or invented by the website assistant. They are confirmed after the actual product, range, quantity, materials, branding, approvals, standards and delivery requirement have been reviewed.

title: Certification and compliance policy
answer: No certification is assumed to apply automatically. Buyers should state the exact certification, safety standard or compliance requirement needed, and applicability must be verified for the specific order before a commitment is made.

title: Repeat and scale orders
answer: Trade buyers can submit repeat-order references and request higher quantities, including container-scale orders. Quantity above the MOQ can be quoted; the MOQ is never a maximum.
